AI.brief_summary: 论文在 NVIDIA 开源 agent harness nooa 中让模型通过 context API 自主决定何时压缩、压缩哪些历史，与 harness 自动 compaction 对比，在文档研究与 ML 工程任务、8K–512K 预算下评测；并展示编辑后复用未变后缀 KV cache 可减少最多 15% prefill 计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 模型自主判断压缩时机与内容，可为 LVR 中「何时停止、丢弃或保留哪部分视觉证据」的状态管理提供对照；其编辑后 KV cache 复用线索也可能供核查 latent 相似度分析中的缓存与注意力结构影响。

title: Plausible Is Not Proven: Testing Failure Explanations in Monocular Depth Estimation
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Code, ratings and results: https://github.com/Md-Zeeshan-Ali/vision-error-observatory
summary: Failure analyses of monocular depth models often name a cause for each error, such as an occluding boundary, a thin object or a reflective surface, but such labels are rarely tested. We present the Vision Error Observatory (VEO), an audit that finds regions failing the $δ_1$ criterion on sensor-measured pixels, labels each with a likely cause or abstains, and then subjects the labels to four tests: agreement with object annotations on data the label model never saw, agreement with blinded human raters, response to targeted image edits, and value as a training signal. We apply it to eight models on NYU Depth V2, DIODE and iBims-1, with labels also checked on Hypersim, and fix most decision rules before their results. The occluding-boundary label agrees with annotations (AUROC 0.85 on NYU, 0.81 on Hypersim, 0.69 on iBims-1), but a single depth-edge cue does as well, and most boundary failures of the strongest model vanish under a 2-pixel tolerance. The reflection label does not transfer to synthetic data, the textureless label is near chance against annotations, and only one of four edit tests, an exploratory one, supports its label. Evaluated against five blinded raters, VEO's labels matched the human consensus only at chance level (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.05). In addition, an increase in the weight on the diagnosed regions during fine-tuning led to an increase in the error on targeted pixels at every weight tested. The architecture-specific failure fingerprint claimed by an earlier version of this project also failed to replicate across the datasets. Plausible failure explanations, in short, need to be tested before they are trusted; we release the protocol, code, ratings and every result file.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Vision Error Observatory 审计协议，在 NYU Depth V2、DIODE、iBims-1 等数据集上为单目深度模型的失败区域标注「可能原因」，再用标注一致性、盲评人类、定向图像编辑和训练信号四类检验考察这些失败解释是否成立，结果多数标签未通过。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「合理解释须先检验」的失败归因流程、单线索基线对照与编辑式因果检验，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 内容归因及失败原因诊断提供可借鉴的审计范式，并提示可解释标签与人评仅达随机水位的陷阱。

title: HAS: Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling for Video Understanding
summary: Due to context-length constraints, most MLLMs cannot process full-length videos and therefore rely on sampling a subset of frames as input. However, existing sampling methods, ranging from uniform sampling to relevance-based selection, are often driven by a single sampling principle and thus struggle to accommodate the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different queries: some demand a holistic understanding of how the video unfolds over time, while others hinge on fine-grained events within a short temporal window. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling (HAS)}, a two-stage frame sampling framework. In the first stage, \emph{Backbone Frame Construction}, we apply a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to sample frames that are both query-relevant and non-redundant. These selected frames capture key moments across the video and form the backbone of the sampling set, providing a foundation for subsequent enrichment. In the second stage, \emph{Adaptive Contextual Enrichment}, we analyze the temporal distribution of the backbone frames to infer the query's requirements and adaptively allocate the remaining frame budget between Local and Global Context. The Local Context enriches the backbone with fine-grained temporal dynamics and short-range causal relations, whereas the Global Context connects temporally isolated evidence and provides a holistic view of the entire video to support global understanding. Through such a hierarchical two-stage process, HAS effectively addresses diverse query requirements. Incorporated into three leading MLLMs, it demonstrates consistently superior performance across the Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HAS 两阶段视频帧采样框架：先用 Determinantal Point Process 选出与查询相关且不冗余的骨干帧，再根据骨干帧的时间分布推断查询需求，把剩余帧预算分配给局部与全局上下文，并在三个 MLLM 与多个视频基准上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按查询需求动态分配视觉证据预算、区分细粒度局部与整体全局证据的思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与计算分配提供可供核查的线索；但该选择发生在模型输入层，与内部 latent 状态的保留和使用关系需读原文判断。

title: ADClaw: A Programmable Visual Agent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ADClaw：无需任务微调的工业异常检测视觉智能体，用结构化正常性先验检索适用规则与正常视觉参照，在持久化工作台中编写执行代码，组合掩码、异常图与测量结果检验缺陷假设，并由证据缺口引导后续检验动作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「假设—代码检验—证据充分性判断」循环与 LVR 关注的多次视觉取证、证据筛选和停止决策直接相关，可供核查多步证据累积与检验成本的建模方式；但未涉及内部表示或 latent 状态生成。

title: Carrying Feature Ablations Across Sparse Autoencoder Seeds
summary: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three settings. The share is 0% in two controls: an SAE whose directions stay random and, post hoc, matches shuffled among trained features. Post hoc, predicting which removals carry is more accurate with layer contributions than with directions. Some incorrect predictions remain. One persists on independent images. So pairs can be screened at the layer. Measuring the output detects errors this screen misses.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 DINOv2 与 SigLIP 某一层的 SAE 上逐一移除特征，比较跨随机种子匹配特征在同一批图像上引起的编码器输出变化是否可“传递”，并对比方向匹配与层贡献对可传递性的预测能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「方向相似却响应不同图像区域」的诊断与消融传递性度量，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度是否真反映视觉内容、以及哪些视觉证据实际贡献于输出，但迁移到推理期状态仍需自行验证。

title: Seeing the Right Context: Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing scene understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret queried targets in relation to nearby objects and surrounding structures, which serve as spatial references or define the scope of an answer. However, standard answers and bounding boxes often leave these contextual relationships implicit. Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K to make them explicit in 5,394 training pairs for visual question answering (VQA), with spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. GeOPD uses these annotations for on-policy distillation, guiding a frozen teacher with region marks on the full image and a visual fact while preserving surrounding spatial references. It prioritizes teacher corrections that agree with the shift in the student's next token distribution when evidence is restored. A complementary objective weights the contrast between the student's scores on the two views by how much masking lowers the teacher's log probability for the same sampled token. Experiments on five remote sensing VQA benchmarks show that GeOPD outperforms the evaluated open-source MLLMs and matched post-training baselines, improving over the 4B and 9B base models by 5.81 and 2.97 percentage points on average. The dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了显式标注空间线索、视觉事实与支撑区域的遥感 VQA 数据集 GeoContext-5K，并提出 GeOPD：用带区域标记的完整图像和视觉事实引导冻结教师做 on-policy 蒸馏，并按恢复证据后学生下一 token 分布的变化来筛选教师纠正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用「掩蔽前后教师对数概率下降幅度」加权学生对两个视图的评分对比，可视为一种视觉证据贡献度量，可供核查是否用于诊断 LVR 中的视觉旁路或信息坍缩，但论文本身面向遥感 VQA 训练而非 latent 状态生成。

title: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^π(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^π\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^π\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, BRIAR expands discourse-aligned reasoning trees along an upper-confidence outcome-bifurcation frontier, steering rollouts away from absorbed rumination and toward unresolved decision points. Second, it models latent node values with boundary-scaled heteroscedastic edge variances and computes exact global posteriors in linear $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ time via two-pass Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) tree belief smoothing, eliminating $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ matrix inversions while gating out spurious boundary noise. Third, BRIAR detects minimal absorbed frontier nodes and applies zero-sum log-length centered suffix advantages strictly post-absorption, leaving pre-absorption derivations provably invariant.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 BRIAR 这一树状 RLVR 框架：把前缀通过概率视为有界 Doob martingale，按结果分叉前沿扩展推理树，用边界缩放的异方差边方差与线性时间 RTS 树信念平滑估计 latent 节点价值，并只在「吸收」节点后施加长度居中的后缀优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本训练期方法，其对节点 latent 价值的树式信念平滑、以及据此识别「已吸收/未决」节点来停止冗余验证的做法，可能为 LVR 中的 latent 状态后验估计、STOP 决策与贡献分配提供方法线索，需核查能否迁移到视觉推理轨迹。

title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model address. The text holds the content. A removable knowledge edit supplies the address through its subject key and supports multi-hop composition. A pair of steering vectors decides, query by query, whether the model adopts the memory or keeps its own answer; the vectors store no content and control how the text memory is used. On frozen models under a pre-registered, test-once protocol, TASK reduces memory-ignoring hallucinations to at most 1.5% in all ten model-dataset cells and cuts neighbour misuse from 39.2% to 7.5% (+10.8 pp composite on CounterFact). It improves a 300-memory library over BM25 RAG by 16.4 pp, an advantage that holds at 3,000 memories, resolves fact revisions without fact IDs, and adds 7.5 pp of multi-hop accuracy on MQuAKE. 21 of 23 cross-model comparisons (8B-27B, four families) are significant, and TASK beats three recent context-steering methods in 9 of 10 model-dataset cells.

AI.brief_summary: 论文诊断 LLM agent 的「使用期记忆幻觉」，将其归因于参数知识与外部记忆的冲突，并提出 TASK memory：以文本承载内容、可移除知识编辑提供地址、成对 steering 向量逐查询决定采纳记忆还是保留自身答案。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「记忆被检索却未被使用／被误用」的诊断与 steering 门控，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据旁路、答案是否真正依赖 latent 内容及证据筛选提供可核查的干预与度量线索。

title: LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
comment: 45 pages. Phase 1 technical report. Project page: https://datamllab.github.io/LoopTitan/ ; code: https://github.com/datamllab/LoopTitan ; models: https://huggingface.co/NaturalScale
summary: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures revisit layer parameters across depths. This design increases effective depth without adding parameters. Recent looped MoE studies report substantial gains over the standard MoE at matched budgets (parameters, FLOPs and KV cache). However, the reported gains still confound parameter revisit with other design choices, e.g., network shape and residual scale. We ask, what does parameter revisit itself buy? Using matched non-revisit controls, we find that parameter revisit itself buys almost nothing. We argue that revisit only offers a freedom an MoE already has, i.e., trading experts for depth (more layers, fewer experts each) at fixed parameters. First, at matched budgets, we decompose the state-of-the-art looped recipe, with revisit last. A non-revisit control retains all the gain. Most comes from network shape, and the rest from residual scale. We prove this scale acts as a lower learning rate on revisited layers. This helps under AdamW's uneven layer step sizes, but disappears under Muon, which keeps them nearly equal. Second, beyond matched budgets, we evaluate revisit by adding compute at fixed parameters. One extra visit gains more than doubling the experts. Yet without revisit, a deeper standard MoE at equal parameters and compute obtains 90.2% of that gain under Muon. Overall, gains come from network shape, the optimizer and added compute, which a standard MoE can adopt. Accordingly, we propose LoopTitan-Base as a stronger MoE baseline. Under Muon, it matches the strongest looped recipe without revisit or residual scale. We open-source LoopTitan and release 17 pretrained models (including LoopTitan-Base and the control). Our experiment record is public as GitHub issues, with predictions pre-registered and the full exploration history kept. This is our Phase 1 technical report, laying the foundation for follow-up studies.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作研究 looped MoE 中「参数复用」本身是否带来收益：在参数、FLOPs、KV cache 匹配下设置非复用对照，拆解网络形状、残差缩放与优化器（AdamW 与 Muon）的贡献，并提出不复用、不加残差缩放的 LoopTitan-Base 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其结论「循环复用几乎不单独带来增益，收益主要来自网络形状、优化器与额外计算」可供核查 loop 式 latent 推理中循环深度的收益归因与匹配对照设计是否充分；该文为纯文本架构研究，向 VLM 推理的迁移属推测。

title: Put the World Back: Timestamps Matter in Time Series Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems. 34 pages. Equal contribution: Tingrui Huang and Yuanyuan Deng
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to time series reasoning. However, current evaluations often give models events in chronological order and already matched to the time series. This makes it unclear whether models use timestamps to connect events with observations or simply take shortcuts. To expose this ambiguity, we reformulate time series reasoning from a world-to-series projection perspective, viewing timestamps as explicit indices that connect numerical observations and external events to shared world states. We identify three structures that timestamps can make explicit: temporal causal structure, time semantics, and event-series alignment. Building on this perspective, we develop a diagnostic protocol that distinguishes timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts, a distinction that accuracy-based benchmarks cannot make. Controlled interventions on 310 questions from two tasks show that high accuracy can persist when timestamps are replaced by relative offsets or removed, while breaking event-series alignment induces systematic failures. When context is pre-aligned, models barely need timestamps. When order is missing, they use dates to recall world knowledge. Without dates, they rely on correlational shortcuts and rarely notice incorrect timestamps. These findings show that high accuracy on pre-aligned, ordered inputs does not establish that a model uses timestamps to synchronize observations with the world. We release our code, model outputs, and trajectory labels at https://github.com/tingrui-huang/timestamps-matter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把时间戳视为连接数值观测与外部事件的显式索引，提出区分「基于时间戳的推理」与相关性捷径的诊断协议，并在 310 道题上做替换、去除时间戳及破坏对齐的受控干预实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其受控干预与轨迹标注的诊断设计可供核查 LVR 中模型是否真用视觉证据而非语言先验或捷径，时间戳这类索引与对齐结构也可能类比 latent 中位置、对齐信息的作用，值得进一步阅读方法细节。

title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
summary: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Mixture-of-Loops Transformer，将 key/value 作为跨深度与循环的选择性复用记忆，并区分保留 residual 流与重启式 loop KV 两种变体；配合 loop forcing 实现并行训练与单次遍历解码，U 形结构则跳过未使用的解码遍历以兼顾效率与质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 循环计算与跨 loop KV 记忆为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代更新、证据复用与缓存结构提供可核查的架构线索；其单次遍历解码超出训练循环数的设定，也可能对应长度泛化与停止决策问题，但原文属纯文本架构，需核查向多模态的迁移性。

title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
comment: Author-revised preprint; journal version published in AI Plus; 20 pages, 3 figures, and 3 tables; position paper and narrative survey
summary: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_θ(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_θ$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $θ$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety and governance for persistent, adaptive systems.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「context scaling」概念，用训练、决策时、上下文基础设施三类预算的框架分析任务所需状态与可用上下文的不匹配，划分可用性、保真度、选择、利用四类失败，并以五步上下文生命周期与效用-成本曲线组织评估议程。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「部署状态 vs 模型可见上下文」的区分与四类上下文失败，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、细节坍塌以及 LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本核算提供概念框架，是否可操作化为度量有待核查。

title: CariesBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Dental Caries Screening and Diagnostic Reasoning from 3D Intraoral Scans
summary: Dental caries assessment is a structured clinical process requiring lesion localization, identification of the affected tooth and surface, and severity grading rather than simple image-level recognition. 3D intraoral scans (IOS) preserve detailed dental geometry and surface morphology and support standardized rendering from complementary viewpoints, enabling fine-grained visual assessment while introducing a distinct need for anatomically grounded multi-view reasoning. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and dental vision-language benchmarks, existing evaluations do not jointly assess hierarchical arch-to-tooth-to-surface reasoning, cross-view evidence integration, and surface-level caries assessment. To address this gap, we introduce CariesBench, a hierarchical benchmark constructed from 5,932 3D IOS, comprising 85,455 standardized multi-view renderings and 133,994 clinically grounded visual question answering instances with expert quality control. CariesBench comprises three complementary task families: Arch-level Clinical Screening (ACS), Tooth-level Diagnostic Reasoning (TDR), and Structured Clinical Decision-Making (SCD). Using the CariesBench training set, we further fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to obtain IntraoralGPT. Extensive evaluation of 24 representative baseline MLLMs reveals a substantial benchmark-level performance disparity between arch-level screening and tooth-level diagnostic reasoning, with higher accuracy on ACS than on TDR. CariesBench-specific supervision substantially improves the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, increasing the 19-task macro-average clinical accuracy from 52.7% to 69.5% and TDR Overall from 34.4% to 44.7%.

AI.brief_summary: 构建基于 5,932 例 3D 口内扫描的分层级多视角龋齿基准 CariesBench，含牙弓筛查、牙位诊断推理与结构化临床决策三类任务，并微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 IntraoralGPT，评测 24 个 MLLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 牙弓→牙位→牙面层级推理与跨视角证据整合的评测，以及筛查易、细粒度诊断难的显著落差，可能为视觉细节保留和多视角证据筛选提供诊断性参照；但任务域特定且无 latent 状态机制，外推价值需核查。

title: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
summary: We present ExtractBench Pro, a schema-guided document extraction benchmark that tests six challenging modes of extraction underrepresented in existing datasets. It is created following a framework for synthetic document generation, in which deterministic document generators assemble challenging components into documents that are designed to be difficult at a level calibrated for frontier systems. We synthesize 100 realistic documents spanning a diverse range of styles. On this data, we evaluate ten coding agents and eight extraction API configurations for accuracy, grounding, and their ability to perfectly extract documents. No extraction system extracts more than 61% of documents error-free. The strongest general-purpose coding agents, Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra, outperform specialized extraction APIs on both perfect-document rate and Value F1, but at a higher cost per page. Among specialized extraction APIs, LlamaExtract spans the lower-cost frontier, with Agentic Plus Max Effort approaching the strongest coding agent on both perfect-document rate and Value F1 at lower cost per page. Our analysis of coding agent traces identifies intelligent image processing and programmatic reasoning, but also failures in applying document-specific definitions and recovering relationships from diagrams. We release ExtractBench Pro and these evaluation results as resources for the future development of improved frontier extraction systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ExtractBench Pro，用确定性合成文档生成框架构造 100 篇长尾文档、覆盖六种困难抽取模式，并评测十个 coding agent 与八种抽取 API 的准确率、grounding 与整篇无误率及成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 schema 引导的视觉文档 grounding 指标与 agent trace 失败分析（图表关系恢复、文档特定定义应用）可供核查「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」及视觉旁路问题，但任务本身偏抽取而非 latent 推理，需进一步判断可迁移性。

title: Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding for Temporally Grounded Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are designed to represent the temporal structure of audio and video, yet it remains unclear how effectively they use this temporal information to relate sounds to visual events. To examine this, we probe an AV-LLM on an audio-visual synchronization task by shifting the audio so that the queried sound overlaps a different visual event. We observe that the model still favors the originally aligned event over the newly aligned one, indicating limited sensitivity to changes in audio-visual temporal alignment. To address this, we propose Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding (MSCD), a training-free decoding method that emphasizes audio-visual temporal alignment in model predictions. MSCD contrasts logits under preserved and disrupted temporal alignment to favor predictions supported by aligned audio and video. We disrupt this alignment by temporally shifting either the audio or the video, while keeping the other modality fixed. Extensive evaluations with two AV-LLMs across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MSCD for temporally grounded audio-visual understanding. In particular, MSCD improves accuracy over the base models on Daily-Omni by 2.2 and 2.8 percentage points for OmniVinci and video-SALMONN 2+, respectively, suggesting that emphasizing temporal alignment can also benefit broader audio-visual understanding.

AI.brief_summary: 通过时间平移音频或视频构造音画错位输入，探测 AV-LLM 是否真正依赖时间对齐信息，并提出免训练的 Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding，用对齐与错位两种条件下的 logits 对比强化由对齐证据支持的预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「模型仍偏向原始对齐事件」的失败观察与 LVR 关注的答案是否真正使用视觉/时序证据、视觉旁路问题直接相关，且对比解码可作为一种免训练的证据筛选与诊断手段供核查；但任务限于音视频同步，向 latent 推理状态的迁移需自行判断。

title: Decoder-as-a-Probe: Verbalizing and Steering Visual Representations in LVLMs
summary: It is commonly accepted that high-level concepts are represented linearly in the representation space of large neural networks. For Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), finding those interpretable directions in visual representations is important for interpretability. To find them, the classical approach is to train a linear classifier on the representations, but it needs a large amount of labels and only recovers what can be read from the representations, not what the model actually uses. In this paper we start from the following insight: The LLM Decoder of an LVLM is also a classifier whose classes are the possible next tokens. So we use its first-order Taylor expansion as a linear classifier. Hence, we introduce Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP), which significantly outperforms classical probing and steering baselines especially when training data is sparse. (1) It verbalizes what an LVLM perceives in a given image. (2) It can surgically change the perception of the LVLM about specific attributes (e.g. change only the color, the clothes worn or the action done). Due to its simplicity and data efficiency, we believe DaP can serve as a plug-and-play tool for LVLM research, such as interpretability, hallucination mitigation or instruction tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Decoder-as-a-Probe（DaP），将 LVLM 的 LLM 解码器的一阶泰勒展开当作线性分类器，从视觉表示中读出模型感知的图像内容，并能定向修改颜色、服饰、动作等特定属性的感知，在标注稀疏时优于传统 probing 与 steering 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 它区分「表示中可读出」与「模型实际使用」，为核查视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、答案是否真正依赖视觉证据提供了低成本探针，与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选兴趣有具体联系，但未涉及 latent 推理轨迹或多步状态更新，需读原文确认其因果性主张。

title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
summary: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 35B 参数（3B 激活）的医学多模态模型 Sage-Med-Preview，以 3.227 亿条记录的分阶段筛选和预训练、分阶段 SFT、自适应 RL 课程训练，并在 238 项临床任务、77 个对比模型上系统评测，报告规模化主要提升文本能力、开启推理模式无法弥合视觉差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「扩规模与开推理模式都补不上多模态感知差距」的诊断为视觉细节是否保留、THINK 的收益与成本提供了直接对照线索，但论文未分析内部状态或 latent 表示，该结论的具体实验条件可供核查。

title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
summary: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「视觉认知共谋」威胁，构建含544个目标案例、33.2K候选图像的跨八领域基准，并给出VisualMontage多智能体框架，通过叙事规划、图像筛选排序与配文分配，诱导VLM智能体在自身推理中接受攻击者指定的目标主张。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准与诊断可直接观察真实图像序列如何逐步改变VLM的结论与信念，可供核查视觉证据筛选、证据累积与结论收敛（停止）等问题，也可以检验内部状态是否保留后续图像可能推翻的视觉细节；但其重心在攻击与防御，未涉及latent状态生成或内部表示，故优先级偏低。

title: BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
summary: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 BOP-Refer 基准，用 9 个 BOP 数据集图像配 VLM 生成并经人工核验的指代表达，从 3D 模型与 6DoF 位姿导出 2D/3D 真值框，并系统评测 17 个前沿 VLM 的单目 2D 与 3D 定位能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其诊断显示模型 2D 定位尚可但深度误差常超过物体尺寸，指向 VLM 内部几何与度量尺度信息保留不足，可作为检验视觉细节是否进入推理状态的证据线索，但论文本身未涉及 latent 推理机制。

title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
summary: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, mathematically plausible but physically infeasible, or rated highly by a judge while quietly breaking a task requirement. We propose a scoring framework that combines a small set of hard checks every answer must pass with a wider set of softer checks whose scores are blended into one number per candidate. This adaptive scoring framework consists of three components: a drafting model that produces the candidates, a configuring model that selects and weights the checks for each task, and scoring models that rate properties no grounded tool can compute. We apply our proposed method to four tasks: writing code that is both correct and secure (CWEval), generating robot manipulation plans (LIBERO with added safety variants), passing competitive-programming hidden tests (LiveCodeBench), and answering questions from retrieved documents (HotpotQA). An ablation study isolates the contribution of each component and finds that the largest gains come from combining hard checks with candidate comparison: on tasks where the first sampled answer is often broken or unsafe, this pairing lifts joint correctness-and-safety by up to +0.21 (retrieval-augmented QA) and code-generation safety by up to +0.28 (CWEval), with the size of the gain tracking how weak the first sample is, falling to near zero or slightly negative where it is already strong. The per-task layer that selects and weights the softer checks adds no measurable value over simpler alternatives. This builds a unified scoring framework, together with an ablation that identifies the grounded hard checks, not the soft-factor configuration, as the source of the gain.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种面向 LLM/VLM 候选答案的测试时评分框架，将少量硬约束检查与可学习的软检查加权结合，并由配置模型为不同任务选择检查项；在代码安全、机器人操作规划、竞赛编程和检索问答上评估，消融显示主要收益来自硬检查与候选比较的配合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“硬约束过滤＋候选比较＋软评分”可作为一种外部验证与答案选择信号，供核查 LVR 中如何筛选视觉证据和支持性候选；但论文未涉及 latent 状态生成、视觉旁路或停止决策，联系较间接。

title: Neighbor Crowding Predicts Feature Stability in Sparse Autoencoders
comment: Accepted at the NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations), NeurIPS 2026, Proceedings track. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offer an approach to identify language model representations by breaking apart polysemantic features into more sparse, interpretable ones. Yet, it is challenging to identify which of the learned features are actually stable, rather than artifacts of initialization. One approach is to train multiple SAE seeds, and compare the learned features across seeds by cosine similarity, but this is notably costly. This raises the question of whether stable features can be identified without the computational expense of training multiple seeds. In this work, we examine cross-seed feature stability across differing levels of training tokens, and demonstrate that in TopK SAEs, it is highly predictable using six computationally cheap statistics derived from a single training run. Neighbor crowding, a geometric property of the dictionary, is the strongest single predictor, with features that sit in dense regions of the unit sphere more likely to be stable than isolated ones.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 TopK SAE 的跨种子特征稳定性随训练 token 数的变化，发现仅用单次训练的六个廉价统计量即可高度预测稳定性，其中「邻域拥挤」这一字典几何性质是最强单一预测因子：位于单位球密集区域的特征比孤立特征更稳定。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「免多次训练即可判断特征是真信号还是初始化伪影」的统计与几何线索，可能可供核查地迁移到 LVR：用于区分内部状态中真实的视觉/推理内容与训练伪影，并为 latent 相似度比较提供几何解读，但仅在文本 SAE 上验证，需核查其跨模态适用性。

title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
summary: Persistent textual memory can improve LLM agents, but repeated updates can erode task performance. We ask whether memory-store statistics warn before held-out accuracy declines. We registered mean pairwise cosine similarity ($ρ$) and 13 additional geometry, retrieval, and graph statistics on 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across ALFWorld, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and two ARC-AGI settings. These methods store trajectories, rules, workflows, strategies, or linked records, using selective retrieval or whole-store prompting. No such statistic reliably predicted early signs of task accuracy decline, and $ρ$ had zero median lead. With the checkpoint after peak accuracy as a secondary decline point, measures of highly similar pairs and nearest-neighbor crowding changed earlier but did not consistently outperform stored-item count. We trained classifiers on this corpus and applied them unchanged to PropWorld runs of up to 5,000 crafting tasks. They falsely flagged 56.9% of checkpoints from size-limited stores with stable accuracy and detected only 18% of checkpoints after task success fell to zero. Thus, global semantic density did not provide a reliable warning, while local crowding did not transfer consistently across memory designs. In these long-horizon runs, size-limited stores remained stable, while the sole failure arose when unbounded whole-store prompting exceeded model input capacity, which token growth predicted directly.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在多种 LLM agent 记忆方法与环境中追踪 805 个快照，检验语义密度等 14 类记忆库统计量能否提前预警任务准确率下降，并测试分类器跨任务迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“全局密度不能稳定预警、局部拥挤指标迁移性差”的负结果，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度或表示几何指标是否真能预测推理失效，避免把状态统计量直接当作坍缩信号。

title: KiRA: Kronecker Input-Gated Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
summary: Full fine-tuning of large pretrained models is expensive, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is the standard alternative. Most PEFT methods use low-rank updates, whose rank lies far below that of full fine-tuning and is the same for every input. Input-adaptive variants vary the capacity per input but remain within the low-rank bottleneck, and whether a task benefits from input conditioning is not known before training. This paper introduces Kronecker input-gated rank adaptation (KiRA). Instead of the conventional low-rank product, the update $ΔW$ is the Kronecker product of a frozen random $p\times p$ matrix $A$ and a trainable factor $M(x)$, which overcomes the rank ceiling: because rank is multiplicative under this product, $A$ multiplies the rank of $M(x)$ by $p$ without adding trainable parameters. The factor $M(x)$ is further decomposed as $B_1\,\mathrm{diag}(g(x))\,B_2$, where the input gate $g(x)$, computed once per sample by a network shared across all adapted layers, adjusts the rank of the update to each input in steps of $p$. Where input conditioning is unnecessary, the gate is folded into $B_1$ at deployment. Because the gate changes the rank only in discrete steps, the benefit of input conditioning can be predicted before training from a few hundred labeled inputs. Across six medical imaging and language benchmarks, KiRA attains the highest mean score against five published baselines with 8.7--9.7 times fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation, and the pre-training criterion agrees with the measured benefit of input conditioning on all six tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 KiRA：以冻结随机矩阵与可训练因子的 Kronecker 积突破低秩更新的秩上限，并用每样本计算一次、跨层共享的输入门控以 p 为步长调节更新秩，还给出训练前用少量标注数据预测「输入条件化是否有益」的判据。
AI.relevance_reason: 每样本共享门控与「预判条件化收益」的判据，可供核查 LVR 中是否值得引入视觉/latent 条件化及如何低成本筛选；但它属训练期 PEFT，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关联，迁移需自行验证。

title: One Token, Many Lessons: Sliding-Window Attention within Gated Delta Networks
summary: Linear attention compresses historical context into a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing the computational and memory costs of long-sequence modeling. From the perspective of test-time regression (TTR), the state matrix can be viewed as an online-learned regression model, where keys and values serve as inputs and targets respectively, and queries are used to read from the model. From this perspective, the effectiveness of state learning depends not only on the update rule but also on how the key-value learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. While existing work has largely focused on how the state is updated and organized, we investigate how the learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. To this end, we propose Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet (SWGDN), which replaces short convolutions in Delta-Rule linear attention with sliding-window attention to perform content-dependent local aggregation of projected queries, keys, and values. Our experiments show that SWGDN makes the key-value pairs used in consecutive updates more similar in both GDN2 and KDA. In SWGDN, carrying information from the same token across updates can help the recurrent state reinforce a previously learned association. The local mixing strategy can be incorporated into any Delta-Rule-based linear attention architecture without changing its state update equations or chunkwise parallel algorithms. We apply this strategy to two Delta-Rule variants, GDN2 and KDA, and experimental results demonstrate that SWGDN outperforms the original Delta-Rule baseline across multiple benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从 test-time regression 视角重新审视线性注意力的循环状态，指出状态学习效果也取决于用于更新的 key-value 学习对如何构造，并提出 SWGDN：用滑动窗口注意力替换 Delta-Rule 线性注意力中的短卷积，对投影后的 query/key/value 做内容相关的局部聚合，在 GDN2 与 KDA 上验证其使相邻更新的键值对更相似、并提升多基准表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注的「状态如何被写入、相邻更新对是否相似、同一 token 信息如何强化既有联想」与 LVR 中 latent 状态的写入与强化、轨迹式状态更新问题可能相关，其不改状态方程与 chunkwise 并行算法的局部混合模块可供核查能否用于多模态 latent 状态的构造；但工作纯属文本语言建模，需判断对视觉证据保留是否有实际收益。

title: Same Tokenizer, Better Tokens: Choosing Image Tokens by MAP Inference
summary:
Discrete visual tokens encode images for reconstruction and serve as training targets for autoregressive image generators. Vector-quantized tokenizers typically assign each encoder feature its nearest code independently. The decoder uses these codes jointly, so a sequence of individually nearest codes can reconstruct an image less faithfully than an alternative assignment. A local model of the reconstruction loss yields a closest-vector problem with a decoder-dependent target and metric. Reconstruction-only search improves PSNR across the frozen tokenizers we test. Different code sequences can achieve similar reconstruction quality, leaving room to favour more predictable ones.
  We introduce RecaP (Reconstruction and Predictability), which selects codes for a frozen tokenizer by balancing how faithfully they reconstruct the image with how likely their sequence is under a pretrained autoregressive prior. On ImageNet, LlamaGen GPT-B trained on RecaP tokens achieves lower early-checkpoint FID against training images than GPT-B trained on nearest-neighbour tokens. The difference is smaller against held-out images. On an ImageNet subset, the prior improves generation at comparable reconstruction FID. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/recap

AI.brief_summary: 该文指出 VQ tokenizer 逐特征取最近码并非解码器最优，提出 RecaP：在冻结 tokenizer 上用局部重建损失做搜索，并把码序列在预训练自回归先验下的似然纳入目标，平衡重建保真与可预测性，在 ImageNet 上改善了早期 FID。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保真度＋先验似然」的离散码选择准则，可能为 LVR 中如何在多个等效 latent 状态间挑选取舍（保留视觉细节 vs. 可解码/可预测）提供可核查的借鉴，但论文本身面向图像生成，不含推理过程。

title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
summary: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出临床取向的心理健康危害分类法，沿「危害是什么、涉及谁、何时发生」三维刻画危害并与干预决策分离，再以短推理轨迹 SFT 加带推理长度惩罚的 RL 训练 35B-A3B 的 guard 模型 MindGuard2，在保持推理收益的同时压低推理开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「短推理轨迹 + 长度惩罚的 RL」为推理预算与停止决策提供了可核查的训练监督线索，可能对应 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的收益-成本权衡与长度泛化；但属纯文本安全分类任务，无视觉状态或证据获取，迁移仅为推测。

title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
summary: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating its premises as the problem. However, a planted proof is only one possible proof. A problem can also have shorter proofs, or several unrelated ones, and its stated depth then overstates what solving it requires. We measure what a problem actually requires, relative to a stated set of inference rules. For each problem, we compute the steps every proof must make, the shortest proof, the number of minimal proofs and the indispensable premises, and export certificates that an independent checker verifies. Audits of eight datasets find depth that is forced (ProofWriter, Blocksworld), problems labelled depth 5 that require about two specific rule applications (FLDx2), and answers that need no particular step (ZebraLogic). We then construct problems whose every proof has a requested structure, using a catalog of shortcuts proved once per rule set. Every constructed problem is checked in full and comes with its own certificate. In training, the best data mixes depths and problem types. At equal size, such mixtures of certified problem types, including model-checking problems that forward generation does not produce, transfer better than FLDx2-style derivation data for Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文审计程序生成逻辑题中「植入证明」深度与实际所需推理步数不一致的问题，计算最短证明、最小证明数、必经步骤和不可或缺前提，并构造带独立证书的无捷径题目，比较不同数据混合对 Qwen 模型训练迁移的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按证明结构认证数据难度并提供训练混合证据的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹监督中的贡献分配、捷径数据筛选和推理长度泛化，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态状态。

title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 Jacobian lens 将 Transformer 隐状态映射为词表或类别方向的 J-space，发现视觉与语言模型的 J-space 大体上仅差一个旋转即可对齐，并用旋转后的方向对 VLM、图像生成器和 ImageNet 分类器做因果干预。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 Jacobian 方向与跨模型旋转对齐可供核查 latent 状态是否编码任务相关视觉证据、以及这些内容是否因果影响输出；但未涉及多步推理或 THINK/LOOK/STOP，联系偏表示几何与干预工具。

title: Large-scale Model Merging via Recovery-aware Task Weighting
summary: Model merging combines multiple task-specific expert models into a single model. However, merging preserves expert capabilities unevenly across tasks. This imbalance is particularly pronounced in large-scale settings, where some tasks can suffer severe capability losses even when average accuracy remains high. To address this imbalance, we introduce Recovery-aware Task Weighting (RaTW), a model merging framework that assigns larger weights to tasks whose expert capabilities are poorly retained by an initial merged model. We quantify these recovery opportunities as the fraction of a task's labeled validation samples that its expert predicts correctly but the initial merged model gets wrong, and use the resulting task weights to re-merge the experts. To evaluate merging at large scale, we construct CLIPMerge-100, a 100-task benchmark with task-specific experts on CLIP ViT-L/14 and ViT-B/32. Across eleven merging methods with 20, 50, and 100 tasks on two CLIP backbones, RaTW improves both mean accuracy and tail20 (the mean expert-normalized accuracy of the 20% worst-retained tasks) in all 33 ViT-L/14 settings and 32 of 33 ViT-B/32 settings. We further introduce ReForge++, which combines RaTW with iterative model refinement and outperforms all evaluated baselines, including a matched-budget control, in both mean accuracy and tail20 across all settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RaTW，用「专家预测正确而初始合并模型错误」的验证样本比例量化各任务的恢复机会，据此给保留较差的任务更大权重并重新合并专家，同时构建 100 任务 CLIPMerge-100 基准与迭代式 ReForge++。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以样本级保留缺口诊断并重分配任务权重的做法，或可供核查多任务/多专家组合时视觉能力丢失的定位与贡献分配，但原文不涉及 latent 推理状态或推理期计算。

title: StyleID++: Position-Decoupled and Structure-Coherent Style Retrieval across Diffusion Architectures
summary: Attention injection offers a remarkably simple route to training-free style transfer: content queries retrieve style keys and values inside a pretrained diffusion model. We show that this operation also creates an overlooked failure mode. Position signals that are useful within one image become a spurious shared coordinate system across two spatially unrelated images, causing content tokens to favor style tokens at similar coordinates. This cross-image positional leakage appears in both convolutional U-Nets and diffusion transformers (DiTs), despite their different position mechanisms. Removing the positional shortcut exposes a second problem: unconstrained global retrieval lets related content tokens select incompatible style regions, producing fragmented appearance. We present StyleID++, a training-free framework that addresses the two problems jointly. Position-Decoupled Retrieval reduces coordinate-dependent matching through circular padding in U-Nets and injection-only RoPE removal in DiTs, while preserving native position modeling elsewhere. Affinity-Coherent Refinement then regularizes style assignments with the content self-attention graph, encouraging structurally related tokens to retrieve compatible style evidence. We quantify the leakage with a coordinate--centroid correlation and a permutation test on the style reference. The permutation error can be driven to zero in both backbones, which identifies the position mechanism as the carrier of the leakage, and StyleID++ obtains the best ArtFID of all methods we compare.

AI.brief_summary: 「StyleID++」针对扩散模型注意力注入式风格迁移，指出跨图像位置泄漏使内容 token 偏向同坐标的风格 token，并提出位置解耦检索与基于内容自注意力图的亲和一致性精化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨图像位置编码构成虚假共享坐标系」的分析可能可供核查跨图视觉证据筛选中的位置捷径，用自注意力图约束检索分配也可作结构一致检索的线索；但任务属图像生成，不直接研究推理。

title: Sparse Adaptation for In-Context Learning on Data Streams
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) generates massive data streams, making edge computing essential for low-latency applications and 5G networks. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable adaptation through in-context examples rather than parameter updates, but evolving streams challenge context relevance and computational efficiency. This work introduces SAIL, a framework for sparse adaptation of TFMs that reuses the model's key--value cache between adaptation events. SAIL reconstructs its support set only when drifts in stream structure indicate potential context inadequacy, while the structural representation itself is updated by changes in predictive performance. SAIL combines prequential error monitoring with online, class-specific micro-clustering to detect changes in cluster mass, class separability, and feature-space coverage. Upon adaptation, a context budget is allocated proportionally to class mass, and the most recently updated micro-clusters provide representative observations for refitting. This limits context redundancy and computational cost while preserving recent structural information.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAIL 框架，用 prequential 误差监控与在线类内微聚类检测数据流结构漂移，仅在上下文可能失效时重建支持集，并复用模型 KV cache，按类质量分配上下文预算，以降低冗余与计算成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时重建上下文、如何复用 KV cache」的触发与预算分配机制，可能为 LVR 中缓存复用、状态刷新时机与停止决策提供借鉴，但面向表格数据流与边缘计算，迁移性需核查。

title: A Hierarchy of Risk Certificates for Representation-Based Prediction
summary: Representation-based prediction underlies many machine-learning systems. Yet a fitted predictor's failure to meet an accuracy requirement does not establish that its representation-decoder class cannot meet it. We study optimal population mean squared error (MSE) over Lipschitz decoders acting on a fixed representation. For blocks of $b\geq2$ independent and identically distributed (iid) observations, we minimize total squared error (normalized by $b-1$) under pairwise Lipschitz constraints. We prove that expected block scores form nondecreasing lower bounds on optimal class risk and converge to that risk on compact metric feature spaces, although no fixed block size provides a uniform relative guarantee. Verified dual lower bounds and iid calibration observations independent of model development, with bounded targets and predictions, yield simultaneous lower confidence bounds on optimal class risk and upper confidence bounds on fitted-predictor risk. These bounds can establish that every admissible decoder exceeds a prescribed MSE threshold or that an admissible fitted predictor meets it. Controlled experiments illustrate population-risk certification; fixed PTB-XL and Bike Sharing experiments provide deterministic empirical-risk conclusions. The results support principled assessment and selection of representation-decoder configurations. Efficient certification at scale and extensions to dependent observations remain open problems.

AI.brief_summary: 在固定表示上研究 Lipschitz 解码器类的最优总体 MSE，证明按分块（b≥2 个 iid 观测）构造的期望分数构成非递减下界，并结合对偶下界与校准数据给出同时置信界，用于判定某解码器类是否必然超过给定误差阈值。
AI.relevance_reason: 其表示—解码器类风险下界与置信界可能可供核查，用于统计判断 latent 视觉状态是否保留下游任务必需信息；但论文为通用表示预测理论，不涉及视觉推理或推理期 latent 生成，迁移性需核查。

title: The Marauder's Map: Bézier Manifolds Reveal Hidden Surfaces for Model Merging and Ensembling
summary: Neural circuits are famously more robust than deep networks. This is often explained through degeneracy, where structurally distinct configurations support the same function. However, real biological systems exhibit a more flexible form of degeneracy in which specialized circuits continually adapt towards new competencies through localized changes while preserving existing function. Deep learning studies degeneracy through mode connectivity, which connects same-task networks by low-loss curves, sheets, or volumes. However, the field lacks a counterpart to flexible degeneracy, which demands more than ordinary mode connectivity. Defining such an analogue requires asking whether many independently initialized models trained on distinct tasks can be connected by a high-dimensional region of multi-task solutions. We introduce $\textit{Nimbus}$, which learns a high-dimensional Bézier manifold connecting $N$ specialists, going beyond the one-dimensional paths and two-dimensional sheets of mode connectivity work. A naive parameterization would scale combinatorially with $N$, but $\textit{Nimbus}$ requires learning corrections of only 3 interaction orders, showing that the connecting manifold has surprisingly low complexity yet supports multi-task competencies. The resulting manifold forms a navigable "Marauder's Map" that connects specialist models through a shared geometry of competent solutions. Trained across vision and language domains, $\textit{Nimbus}$ produces manifolds that are functionally and locally weight-flat: ensembles sampled from them degrade more gracefully than baselines under input and weight perturbations, with the largest gains in NLL loss and calibration error. $\textit{Nimbus}$ supplies a deep learning interpretation of flexible degeneracy, recasting model connectivity from a low-dimensional path between distant solutions into a high-dimensional volume of nearby ones.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Nimbus，用仅需学习三种交互阶校正的高维 Bézier 流形连接 N 个不同任务的专家模型，形成可导航的多任务解几何，并在视觉与语言任务上检验其采样集成对输入与权重扰动的稳健性和校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以低阶交互校正参数化多专家组合的方式，可供核查能否用于合并或组合 VLM 中多个特长模块乃至 latent 推理状态，但与视觉证据筛选、THINK/LOOK/STOP 等主线问题无直接联系。

title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
summary: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DDxBasis，在冻结基础编码器上用概念瓶颈（门控二阶 slot attention 逐层读取 patch token）把概念重组为「诊断对极」轴，从而以少量发现给出可精确拆分的鉴别诊断解释，并在五个医学数据集上验证准确性与解释紧凑性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「每个概念自带证据、决策可精确加性拆分」及用反事实编辑核查边界病例的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但任务本身不涉及多模态推理生成。

title: DreamTour: Layout Steering for Training-Free World Exploration
summary: Video diffusion and world models generate plausible videos but do not reliably match the requested camera direction and travel distance. We present DreamTour, a training-free framework that generates camera tours from a single image with more accurate control over camera motion. DreamTour first uses a frozen image inpainting prior to extend the photograph beyond its original field of view while preserving the input pixels. Depth-based rendering of this extended scene along the requested camera path produces approximate target views that serve as spatial guidance. We introduce Layout Steering, which aligns early video latents with these views through decaying low-frequency corrections, leaving later denoising to refine appearance and dynamics. For longer tours, we autoregressively generate the video segments, repeating guidance construction from each segment's final frame to maintain camera control across the full trajectory. DreamTour improves directional accuracy and travel calibration on VBench while maintaining competitive video quality. On WorldScore, it strengthens camera control and scene consistency across chained movements. Together, these results demonstrate that training-free spatial guidance enables more accurate and consistent camera control in pretrained video diffusion and world models.

AI.brief_summary: DreamTour 是免训练框架：先用冻结的 inpainting 先验扩展单图视野，再按指定相机路径做深度渲染得到近似目标视图，随后以衰减的低频校正把早期视频 latent 对齐到这些视图，长轨迹则分段自回归并用每段末帧重建引导。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关联；但其把几何渲染视图以衰减低频校正写入早期 latent、并靠末帧递推维持引导的做法，可能为「视觉证据如何注入并保持于 latent 工作区」提供可供核查的方法线索。

title: Confidence scores for gated automation of large language models
summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated decision-making. However, LLMs may produce incorrect answers with high confidence, limiting their applicability in decisions that affect individuals and organizations. Reliable confidence scores are necessary to gate such decisions, and existing estimates are frequently unavailable or too coarse to support effective gating. This work uses supervised learning to train models to predict the correctness of LLM-generated answers, enabling automated confident responses and routing uncertain ones for human review. A linear confidence score head is fitted to the final-layer hidden state of the frozen LLM backbone, and text-only metamodels are trained as an alternative for closed models. All results come from a single 2B-parameter backbone, on graded answers that are about 98% SQuAD and the remainder TruthfulQA. Against multiple baselines, the confidence score head outperforms all baselines and metamodels, automating the largest fraction of the workload at high accuracy targets. Prompted confidence scores can appear well calibrated yet lack the resolution needed for thresholding. Although transferability to unseen datasets is modest, the confidence score head remains the most robust approach. The proposed confidence scoring framework enhances the safety of automating LLM-based agents and can be adapted to gate other properties, including safety or compliance.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用监督学习训练置信度评分器判断 LLM 答案是否正确，在冻结的 2B 模型末层隐状态上拟合线性头，并以纯文本元模型作对照，用于自动放行或转人工复核。
AI.relevance_reason: 其利用隐状态预测正确性并按阈值分流的思想，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与人工介入门控提供线索；但仅涉文本和单一骨干，跨任务迁移有限，需核查该置信信号能否用于多模态推理轨迹。

title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
comment: Published at fifth conference on lifelong learning agents
summary: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 提出即插即用的 SACK：将模型的类别知识拆解为细粒度概念，计算已学概念与新经验中概念的关系，并据此对新样本排序，配合正则化、回放与 prompt 类持续学习方法提升准确率、减少遗忘。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但「按与当前知识的语义关系给样本打分排序」这一训练侧机制可能可供核查，用于 latent 推理轨迹或视觉证据样本的优先级筛选与监督分配；其本身不涉及多模态推理状态或 latent 生成，迁移需较多论证。

title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
summary: AI models vary enormously in capability and price. Model routing exploits this by sending easier tasks to cheaper models. However, a single agentic task often combines easy and difficult subtasks, making one model choice for the entire task inefficient. We introduce partial routing, which guides a frontier lead model to delegate suitable subtasks to a cheaper worker model. From both models' past runs, we identify recurring subtasks and measure each model's quality and cost on them. These measurements produce delegation guidance, with a parameter, $δ$, controlling how much is delegated. The lead decides when and what to delegate during execution, without training either model. On held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0, partial routing achieves higher mean task performance than the lead alone and task-level routing. With $δ= 0.75$, it raises the lead's ViBench score from 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and its Terminal-Bench pass rate from 54% to 61% at similar cost. Giving the lead only the subtask breakdown, without a worker, also reduces cost on both benchmarks and raises the Terminal-Bench pass rate. These results show that analysis of past runs can support more efficient planning and more effective delegation, with little cost and implementation overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 agentic workflow 中的「部分路由」：让前沿主模型按历史运行中识别的重复子任务，把合适子任务委派给更便宜的 worker 模型，并据质量与成本生成委派指导，无需训练模型。在 ViBench 和 Terminal-Bench 上，该方法优于单一主模型和任务级路由，并降低部分成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按子任务质量与成本决定「何时外包计算」的机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本收益权衡提供方法线索；但路由信号能否对应视觉推理步骤仍需核查。

title: A Semantics-First Approach to Multimodal Video Captioning with Frozen Encoders and Stabilized Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Preprint correcting minor typographical errors and clarifying baseline evaluation conditions from the SPIE Defense + Security 2026 proceedings
summary: We propose the Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer), a highly efficient architecture built upon a 2.7B parameter LLM featuring a fixed-length $K=16$ semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training (ASCST) with Entropy Regularization. Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) often rely on global audio representations to compensate for inefficient, frame-based visual encoders. While our Phase 1 prompted evaluations demonstrate that the Multimodal Base Model achieves strong deep semantic alignment (scoring 0.889 on BERTScore F1), optimizing this architecture for legacy metrics reveals a performance gap. We explore this gap as a hypothesis we term temporal alignment friction: a conflict where global audio representations disrupt the chronological sequence of visual frames, leading to penalties under visually-focused evaluation metrics. Consequently, by stripping away the audio, our Video-Only ablation conforms more closely to this rigid syntax, achieving 63.0 CIDEr. While trailing larger models such as Qwen2.5-VL (67.4 CIDEr), this establishes a strong baseline for sub-3B parameter LLM-based models. This indicates that CIDEr, as applied to datasets such as MSR-VTT, may exhibit a bias toward visually grounded syntax, limiting its ability to fully capture multimodal semantic richness.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AVQFormer：在 2.7B LLM 上接入固定长度 K=16 的语义对齐模块做音视频描述，并用熵正则化的自适应 self-critical 序列训练稳定优化；通过去音频消融讨论「时间对齐摩擦」与 CIDEr 指标对视觉语法的偏向。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定槽位语义压缩与熵正则的序列训练可供核查 latent 状态容量/信息坍缩及轨迹训练稳定性，但研究目标是视频描述指标而非推理期 latent 内容的使用与停止决策，联系较弱。

title: Collaborative Language Models for Semantic IoT Data Processing: Validation through Zero-Shot Human Activity Recognition
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) systems generate low-level sensor observations that are not directly suitable for process analysis and must first be transformed into semantically meaningful events. This paper investigates collaborative language models as a zero-shot semantic abstraction layer for converting such observations into higher-level event and activity labels. We propose a five-stage workflow comprising semantic mapping, semantic aggregation, temporal and contextual aggregation, specialized reasoning, and final event abstraction. The resulting labels and contextual information can subsequently be represented as event records for downstream Process Mining (PM) tasks. The approach is evaluated through Human Activity Recognition on the CASAS Aruba smart home dataset using eleven workflow configurations. The experiments show that collaboration alone does not guarantee improved performance: general-purpose auxiliary SLMs can degrade recognition, whereas assigning complementary specialist roles leads to better results and allows a smaller final classifier to retain much of the performance of a larger model. The selected workflow achieves a macro F1 of 0.643 in the 1.5-day comparison and 0.567 (weighted F1 0.680) in a one-week evaluation. Although trained ML approaches remain more accurate on this dataset, the results demonstrate a different design point: modular semantic event abstraction using off-the-shelf models without task-specific parameter fine-tuning. The findings indicate that the structure of LM collaboration and task decomposition is more important than simply increasing the number of participating models.

AI.brief_summary: 该文将多个语言模型组合为「零样本语义抽象层」，用语义映射、聚合、时序与上下文聚合、专门化推理、事件抽象五个阶段把 IoT 底层传感器观测转换为高层活动标签，并在 CASAS Aruba 智能家居数据上用十一种流程配置评估人类活动识别效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分阶段语义抽象与「角色互补才增益、单纯增加模型反而变差」的结论，可供核查多级推理状态抽象、角色分工与贡献分配在 LVR 流程中的设计取舍；但场景非视觉、无 latent 状态，迁移性待验证。

title: Beyond Random Starts: Amortized Initialization for Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Models
summary: Gradient-based transferable adversarial attacks achieve state-of-the-art attack success rates against black-box vision-language models (VLMs). However, they require hundreds of costly optimization steps for each image pair. One possible reason is that these attacks typically start from random perturbations that contain no information about the source or target image. In this work, we study whether amortized adversarial generation can provide better initializations for gradient-based attacks. By learning across many image pairs, amortization allows a generator to produce adversarial perturbations for new inputs without optimizing each perturbation from scratch. We introduce SPARK, a lightweight looped perturbation generator conditioned on both the source and target images. SPARK repeatedly applies the same network to refine a perturbation, producing effective adversarial attacks in a few forward passes without requiring gradients through surrogate vision encoders at inference time. We show that these perturbations provide effective warm starts for existing gradient-based attacks, substantially improving attack success rates while reducing the number of optimization steps required. These improvements generalize across different attack methods, VLMs, and unseen image categories. SPARK also produces effective standalone attacks at a fraction of the computational cost of gradient-based optimization. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/Patchwork53/SPARK.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPARK：一个以源图与目标图为条件的轻量循环扰动生成器，通过对多组图像对的摊销学习，用少量前向迭代反复细化扰动，为 VLM 黑盒对抗攻击提供热启动并降低梯度优化步数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享权重的循环网络少量迭代细化同一状态」和摊销初始化思路，可能为 LVR 的 looped latent 状态更新、初始状态设定与计算成本权衡提供线索，可供核查；但论文目标是攻击迁移而非视觉推理，未涉及 latent 语义内容是否被使用。

title: Temporal Selective Exploration for Reinforcement Learning-Guided Continuous-Discrete Flow Matching in 3D Molecular Design
summary: Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains underexplored, especially in continuous-discrete mixed settings. Moreover, flow matching is formulated as an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), whose deterministic trajectories do not naturally support RL optimization. Introducing stochasticity by converting the entire trajectory into a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) is a common practice. Nevertheless, not all timesteps contribute to the final outcomes, and redundant exploration introduces additional noise. Furthermore, in multi-objective settings, some objectives may dominate the optimization while others receive insufficient updates. In this study, we propose an RL-guided continuous-discrete flow matching framework with temporal selective exploration for 3D de novo molecular design. Specifically, our method jointly optimizes continuous and discrete flow matching for atomic coordinates and molecular identities, respectively, while restricting exploration to timesteps that primarily contribute to target properties, reducing ineffective exploration. We also introduce a reward-based advantage calibration mechanism to mitigate objective dominance in multi-objective optimization. The framework is applied to design inhibitors for both the well-studied target protein EGFR and the challenging Pin1 protein. We identify some novel candidate inhibitors, supported by in silico validation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出面向 3D 从头分子设计的 RL 引导连续-离散 flow matching 框架：联合优化原子坐标与分子身份的连续、离散流，只在主要影响目标性质的 timestep 上引入随机探索，并用基于奖励的优势校准缓解多目标优化中的目标支配，用于 EGFR 与 Pin1 抑制剂设计。
AI.relevance_reason: 「仅在关键时间步探索」以及按贡献定位有效更新，可能对应 LVR 中只在关键推理步骤采样、判断各步对答案贡献的问题，可供核查；但分子生成场景本身不在视觉多模态推理主线，迁移性需较多推断。

title: Anatomy-Aware Pseudo-Labels and Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff Supervision for Semi-Supervised Pancreas Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to WACV 2027 Workshops (FABRIC). \c{opyright} 2027 IEEE
summary: Confidence-gated co-training assumes that pseudo-label errors are uncertain and concentrated at organ boundaries. We argue that for pancreas CT, where the target organ is a single connected structure and detached fragments are anatomically implausible, the dominant failures arise at three levels: where the organ is, what its boundary should look like, and how a correct boundary is penalized. Anatomical Rectification relabels implausible fragments of a teacher prediction as confident background, without adding any loss or parameter; an audit confirms that its rejections are overwhelmingly detached hallucinations and that thin, tail-like slices are not eroded. Boundary Grafting transplants labelled surface regions with their annotation into unlabeled volumes, replacing unreliable boundary pseudo-labels with ground truth. The residual error is coherent surface displacement, weakly penalized by permutation-invariant Dice and cross-entropy losses. Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff (HAH) supervision anneals a distance-weighted penalty from an annotation-anchored objective that is convex in the prediction to a Hausdorff surrogate, admitting the prediction-dependent distance term only after the predicted surface becomes reliable. On NIH pancreas CT, under the standard semi-supervised split, the full method reaches 84.60% Dice and 4.97 voxels 95HD, improving all four metrics over compared methods; on MSD Task07, 78.90% Dice and 4.19 voxels 95HD.
