title: Commit2Drive: Perception-Grounded Language Decisions as Commitments for Trajectory Planning in Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 19 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code will be released soon
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models introduce language reasoning into end-to-end autonomous driving. They output a language decision together with a trajectory, which makes the planner more interpretable. However, in existing methods the language decision is either an independent output or an index that selects among similar candidate trajectories, and its annotations are not verified against the trajectory. As a result, the language decision and the trajectory are often inconsistent in closed-loop driving. To address this, we propose Commit2Drive, a framework that imposes the language decision as a consistency constraint on trajectory planning. The decision is a commitment, a maneuver class with a continuous parameter that one deterministic rule reads from any trajectory, and it is grounded in facts reported by the perception of the model itself. A Maneuver Bank maps the commitment to a code with a kinematic meaning, and consistency losses train the planner to execute every admissible decision of a scene, so that the trajectory follows the decision. An automatic data pipeline supplies the supervision. Decisions are labeled from the future motion of the expert, counterfactual executions train the decision and the trajectory together, and rule-based functions with a Vision-Language Model (VLM) generate, review and refine the language annotations. The code is a lookup that involves no hidden state of the language model, so Commit2Drive is extensible to rule-based decisions, which the same planner executes without retraining. Commit2Drive uses a 0.5B language model and runs closed-loop inference online on a single consumer graphics card. On Bench2Drive, Commit2Drive reaches a Driving Score (DS) of 78.50 and a Success Rate (SR) of 55.91% with a lightweight model, which is competitive with the state of the art, and greatly reduces the language-action inconsistency. Code will be released soon.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Commit2Drive：把语言决策定义为带连续参数的机动类「承诺」，由确定性规则从任意轨迹读出并以模型自身感知事实为据，配合机动码本、一致性损失与反事实执行联合训练规划器，另有 VLM 辅助的自动标注管线，在 Bench2Drive 闭环取得 78.50 DS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语言决策—轨迹」一致性约束与反事实监督可供核查 VLM 推理中答案是否真正作用于输出、以及贡献分配与监督设计；但决策码仅由查表得到、不涉及语言模型隐状态，与 latent 状态生成关系较远，迁移价值需人工判断。

title: Beyond Pose Control: Anatomically Consistent Ultrasound Video Generation
summary: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向探头位姿可控的超声视频生成，在位姿条件之外引入由人群数据构建、并随每个生成块在线细化的解剖先验，以及按超声断面物理设计的 3D latent memory，将已生成切片累积为患者体数据并在新位姿处重切片，以改善未扫描区域与重复回访时的解剖一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「3D latent memory」作为随生成过程在线更新的持久内部状态、并按新位姿重新取用，可为 LVR 中跨步骤维护与查询 latent 空间状态、以及状态在视角或位置变化下的一致性问题提供方法线索；但该工作目标是逼真视频合成，未涉及证据获取与推理决策，需核查其状态更新与查询机制是否可迁移。

title: HoMe: Toward Practical Harness Optimization of Memory Systems for AI Assistants
summary: The behavior of memory systems for long-running AI assistants is governed by a harness, which consists of the code, prompts, and configurations for memory construction, maintenance, retrieval, and answer generation. However, optimizing the harness of a memory system remains largely manual, and unrestricted editing alone does not ensure structural improvements. In this paper, we introduce HoMe, an evaluation-driven framework that iteratively evaluates candidate harnesses and derives each new candidate from any previously evaluated harness by editing any part of it. HoMe combines session-level memory versioning with execution traces to identify shared failure mechanisms across cases and localize them to the responsible sessions and harness components. It encourages early structural exploration through candidate gating and reduces evaluation cost through smoke tests, adaptive sampling, and the reuse of constructed memory. We validate HoMe with the open-source memory system ReMe on two large-scale long-horizon memory benchmarks, LongMemEval-S and BEAM. With six formal candidate evaluations per benchmark, after a full initial evaluation, HoMe discovers harnesses that improve end-task performance over the originally strong harness while consuming far fewer query-time tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HoMe，一个评估驱动的 harness 优化框架：迭代评测候选 harness 并对其任意部分（记忆构建、维护、检索、答案生成）进行编辑，借助会话级记忆版本与执行轨迹定位跨案例的共享失败机制，并用 smoke test、自适应采样和记忆复用来压低评估成本，在 LongMemEval-S 与 BEAM 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选 harness 迭代评测 + 失败机制定位 + 低成本筛选」流程，可能可供核查地迁移到 VLM 推理中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 控制策略与证据获取流程的自动优化；但论文自身不涉及视觉输入或 latent 状态，联系仅为方法论层面。

title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models
summary: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades requires the output of every model on every item, and its cost. Stored collections built for routing keep no per-option probabilities. We provide a dataset on which ensemble methods, routers and cascades are simulated quickly, without new model calls. DecisionReplay holds the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models, endpoints that return a probability for every answer option, on 35 benchmarks, with the token counts, billed cost and measured latency of every call, all released. A deterministic simulator replays any policy that selects, combines or cascades them. One well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat: pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it, and stacking gains 1.0 points at 3.4 times its cost. The models are wrong together: two that are both wrong choose the same wrong option in 72% of cases. The best router matches that model at 64% of its cost, and certified early exit cuts the cost of a stacked ensemble by 43% without changing an answer. DecisionReplay makes it cheap and fast to test whether a new method changes these results.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 DecisionReplay 语料与确定性离线模拟器，记录 17 个商业决策模型在 35 个基准上的逐选项概率、token 数、成本与延迟，以低成本回放路由、集成与级联策略，并报告单模型难被超越、模型错误高度相关、认证式早退降本等结论。
AI.relevance_reason: 其带成本与延迟的离线策略回放可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 阈值与多 latent 假设集成的收益成本评估，错误共现统计也可能提示假设多样性的度量方式；但对象为非视觉决策模型，迁移需较多核查。

title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
summary: Large pretrained language models provide capable policies for interactive tasks, but how much model capacity is necessary for a specialized language agent? We introduce ZeroHero, a framework for training small language agents (SLAs) from scratch. In each environment, a large language model acts as the expert, and we collect its successful trajectories. We pretrain each SLA, which has fewer than 50 million parameters, to predict the expert's responses given the interaction history. We then post-train the agent on its own interactions using proximal policy optimization (PPO). During post-training, reasoning alignment supplements environment rewards with expert supervision on the language the agent generates alongside its actions. We evaluate the agents in three multistep environments where acting requires both understanding and generating language. In Crafter, agents interpret textual observations and generate reasoning before acting. In WebShop, they translate shopping instructions into search queries. In Alfworld-Dialogue, they ask clarifying questions and use the answers to guide household actions. The agents approach expert performance on WebShop and surpass their respective demonstration experts on Crafter training rollouts and held-out Alfworld-Dialogue tasks. An interactive demo is available at https://zoyav.github.io/-ZoyaV-zerohero-demo.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ZeroHero，从头训练不足 5000 万参数的小型语言智能体：先用大模型成功轨迹预训练，再用 PPO 在自身交互上后训练，并加入对生成语言的专家监督式推理对齐；在 Crafter、WebShop 和 Alfworld-Dialogue 中评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其成功轨迹预训练、PPO 后训练与语言推理对齐，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹监督、贡献分配及生成语言与动作协同训练等线索。

title: PRAM: Activating Latent Multimodal Knowledge through Partwise Reasoning
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://luo1yan.github.io/PRAM/ ; Code: https://github.com/Luo1Yan/PRAM ; Features: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Rowance/PRAM-features
summary: Emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval enable transfer between modalities without direct paired supervision. However, existing methods often prioritize sample-level alignment, overlooking local discriminative information and partwise statistical relations. To this end, we propose partwise reasoning across modalities (PRAM), which activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality. Specifically, we first present a multi-granularity covariance regularization module that estimates covariances from global and local vectors in two collections of modality-pivot pairs, stabilizing local estimates through adaptive blending with their cross-part means. Second, we devise a pivot-based spectral relational reasoning module that infers global and partwise statistical relations between target modalities through regularized covariance composition and extracts paired projection directions and their correlation strengths via whitening and spectral decomposition. Finally, we introduce a multi-granularity score fusion module that standardizes and fuses matching scores from global and local relations, incorporating task-specific information on pivot associations and class semantics for class prediction and candidate ranking. Extensive experiments across ten datasets demonstrate that PRAM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 16 classification settings and 19 retrieval settings, while exhibiting highly competitive performance in three sensing scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: PRAM 在冻结编码器上借助共享枢轴模态组合全局与局部的协方差统计关系，经白化与谱分解提取配对投影方向，再融合多粒度分数，用于跨模态分类与检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分部件统计关系与协方差组合可能为 LVR 中局部视觉细节、实体关系的内部表示及免训练适配提供线索，但论文面向分类检索、未涉及推理状态生成，可供核查迁移性。

title: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.

AI.brief_summary: 面向基于模型的强化学习提出 VIBES，用对抗式变分目标替代像素重建，要求潜状态足以预测奖励与下一潜状态，并配合固定容量瓶颈抑制任务无关的干扰信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「奖励与动力学充分性」约束加瓶颈的表示学习信号，可供核查 LVR 中应保留哪些视觉细节、如何抑制无关变化的训练设计；但该工作属 RL 世界模型，未涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 推理状态生成。

title: Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics
summary: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MotionRep 世界模型：用 DINO-VAE 对高维 DINO 特征做时序与通道压缩，再以统一 diffusion transformer 在初始观测、物体查询点和语言指令条件下联合预测未来 DINO 表示与 3D object flow，并用非对称噪声调度让视觉流先于几何流。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以预测式视觉潜表示作为未来状态空间」与 LVR 关心的 latent 是否保留视觉细节和几何、以及表示如何被后续使用直接相关，可供核查其 DINO 潜空间压缩与信息保留情况；但该工作是具身操作动力学预测，而非 VLM 推理，迁移需较多核查。

title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
summary: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. We analyze gradients and an early training update to provide local evidence that updates learned at one ratio can benefit compression at other ratios. These results show that LLift can improve compression across deployment budgets without fine-tuning each compressed model separately.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LLift：以原模型为教师，在单一压缩比下微调低秩近似，再把更新合并回原权重并保留训练中被排除的互补分量，随后对目标矩阵做 SVD 并在不同截断秩复用同一分解，从而让一个 checkpoint 服务多种压缩预算而无需逐比例微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但「单一预算训练、跨秩复用分解」及保留互补分量的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态在低秩瓶颈下的信息保留与多计算预算共享工作区的训练方式提供核查线索。

title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
comment: 23 pages, including appendix. Video examples provided as ancillary files
summary: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

AI.brief_summary: ShowNow 提出细粒度投机流式框架，利用播放期间的空闲算力预先准备动作条件下的多个未来（1–8 个），并结合 single-latent commitment 与共享历史树执行，降低交互式世界模型的输入到显示延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预备多个候选未来＋细粒度提交」的投机执行与提交时机设计，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的并行维护、验证及何时停止或提交提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身面向视频世界模型而非视觉推理。

title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. For occluded-pedestrian emergence, five rounds of post-training improve the critical-phase collision-free rate on the sealed test set from 0.261 to 0.579 for AutoVLA and from 0.390 to 0.765 for ReCogDrive, while the unnecessary braking rate in paired control scenarios never exceeds 0.013. On a full-scale vehicle without real-world training, post-trained ReCogDrive achieves 4 of 5 safe passages, versus 1 of 5 for the base model. Fine-grained evaluation reveals a pattern obscured by the collision-free rate alone: both VLA models learn anticipatory deceleration before reaching the occluding vehicle, while braking after pedestrian emergence remains limited. For stop-sign yielding, the stop-before-line rate rises from 0.100 to 0.897 for AutoVLA and from 0.000 to 0.667 for ReCogDrive. With sequential training from the pedestrian-capability models, it reaches 0.599 and 0.358, respectively, while the pedestrian collision-free rate decreases by at most 0.032.

AI.brief_summary: 提出失败驱动的数据飞轮用于 VLA 模型后训练：在重建的真实场景中插入任务相关实体以构造缺失的目标场景，按任务行为要求逐项评估模型，用失败率构成跨条件与难度的失败图，并据此分配下一轮数据生成配额；在自动驾驶的遮挡行人出现与停车标志让行场景中对两个 VLA 模型进行多轮后训练与仿真/实车验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 按失败条件分配数据生成配额的做法可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中把监督资源集中到失败条件的策略提供线索；其细粒度评估发现模型只学到「到达遮挡车前预先减速」而「行人出现后制动」仍不足，可供核查视觉证据使用时序与 latent 状态是否真正承载关键视觉信息。

title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
summary: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把「小代理模型为大模型挑选训练数据时排序不一致」的问题建模为多保真 bandit：用配对残差校正代理奖励，仅在不确定决策上花审计预算，并给出 regret 分解与下界；在 CivilComments-WILDS 上用 BERT-Small 指导 BERT-Large 训练，提升最差组准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 代理奖励与真实目标奖励不一致、以及「廉价代理每轮可得、昂贵真值仅稀缺审计」的预算分配，可能为 LVR 中如何选择性投入昂贵验证、如何校正代理信号下的贡献分配提供可核查线索；但原文面向训练数据采样而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性需自行判断。

title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 INSPIRE 两阶段时序知识图谱预测框架：第一阶段在完整候选目录上训练可用性感知的共享模式预测器，第二阶段冻结该预测器并用轻量个体证据适配器融合文本语义先验与相关加权的事件统计。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及视觉或多模态，但其「冻结共享预测器＋轻量个体证据适配器」以及支持/角色平衡监督与先验去除偏差，可能为 LVR 中共享先验与个体视觉证据的整合、证据贡献分配提供方法线索，可供核查。

title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate cross-view interaction. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers-inspired framework that reads complementary knowledge from spatially aligned RGB and wavelet views within a fully frozen visual foundation. ReMoT employs staged joint attention to enable controlled local and global cross-view interaction, while learnable fusion queries progressively read complementary evidence across Transformer depth without writeback. ReMoT achieves 91.2% average accuracy across eight benchmark groups with 3,074 trainable parameters, attaining the highest overall average among the evaluated methods. These results support structured knowledge readout as a promising alternative to backbone adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ReMoT，在完全冻结的视觉基础模型内，用受 Mixture-of-Transformers 启发的分阶段联合注意力与可学习融合查询，从空间对齐的 RGB 与小波视图逐层读取互补证据，用于 AI 生成图像检测，仅需约三千可训练参数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不回写、以查询沿 Transformer 深度读取冻结中间表示」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中深度位置如何影响 latent 证据读出与表征保真；但任务为伪造图像检测，与多模态推理生成无直接关联。

title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对阿尔茨海默病诊断中模态缺失问题，提出「Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers」：模型按模态逐个采样多条填补轨迹，由训练期才有信息的填补教师逐步打分、诊断教师提供软目标，以 on-policy 蒸馏训练出单次 rollout 即可诊断的校准模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐步随机填补加上教师逐步评分与软目标，可能为 LVR 中采样 latent 中间状态、用训练期监督引导并校准缺失视觉证据下的置信度提供方法线索；但属医学多模态诊断，其状态是否真被答案使用尚需核查。

title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
comment: 31 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/maxipetro/lens-diffing-backdoors
summary: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文建立基于 token readout 的统一评分体系，比较权重、激活与输出三类 model diffing 方法在微调后门检测中的表现，并用 J-lens 及 J++-lens 改进权重与激活方法；实验中 ΔW J++ 最强，但无单一方法能同时抵御两类攻击。

title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
summary: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weight models, SEPO ranks first in 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty, while no baseline leads in more than two. On average, it raises LLM-judged diversity from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 over base sampling (1-5 scale), with quality decreasing from 3.72 to 3.30. We further show that expanding the optimized ensemble increases separation among prompt-conditioned response distributions. These results support system prompt ensemble optimization as a promising approach to improving LLM creativity at inference time.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把创意生成建模为质量、多样性与新颖性的多目标分布优化问题，提出免训练的 SEPO：用 prompt 进化配合带质量约束的贪心 max-min 选择找出行为差异大的系统提示，并在推理时每条回复随机采样一个提示。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属纯文本创意生成，不涉及视觉或 latent 状态；但其在质量约束下用 max-min 选择维持提示条件分布间距的做法，可能为 LVR 中避免 latent 假设坍缩、保持多路推理模式多样性提供可核查线索。

title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.

AI.brief_summary: SPLICE 针对长程 agent RL 中「整组轨迹全失败、零奖励」导致组相对优势失去梯度的问题，在线从当前策略的失败轨迹中选 splice 点并生成若干有界选项，用重复续写估计各选项价值，把正估计转成回报加权的局部目标来更新策略，并在 SWE-bench Verified 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上对比 GRPO 与全轨迹引导基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「局部片段 + 分支续写价值估计」的构造可能为 latent 推理轨迹的分段监督、贡献分配以及继续/停止决策提供借鉴线索，但工作限于纯文本 agent、缺少视觉状态，可供核查该局部目标能否用于内部推理状态的价值估计。

title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
summary: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RevFlow，把图像生成视为编码的逆过程：以冻结视觉编码器的中间表示为逐级生成目标，先生成深层语义表示，再生成保留外观与空间细节的浅层表示，最后解码到像素；并用共享 DiT 骨干、按阶段注入条件的 HyC-DiT 统一各阶段，借助语义表示空间的原生匹配实现少步生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其沿编码器深度逐级生成隐状态、共享骨干加阶段条件注入以及少步匹配采样的设计，可能为 LVR 中多层级 latent 状态的构建与高效更新提供方法线索，阶段间细节保留与条件注入方式可供核查。

title: SceneDesigner3D: Agentic Evolutionary Search for Principled Rearrangement of 3D Indoor Scenes
summary: Scene rearrangement is an essential task for 3D content creation applications, requiring generation of diverse, aesthetic and functional scene rearrangements. We present SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D indoor scene rearrangement that systematically explores the design space of 3D scenes and generates multiple solutions according to common interior design principles. Given an input scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D represents the rearrangement as an editable program and evolves a population of candidate layouts. Starting from distinct design ideas, a VLM agent mutates the programs by refining promising candidates, exploring new rearrangement strategies or redesigning from scratch, while verifying the layouts for physical validity. Proposals are scored by a VLM judge for adherence to the input prompt and satisfaction of design principles such as balance, zoning and emphasis, as well as numerically computed principles such as circulation and clutter. An archive of top-performing, structurally varied candidates further increases diversity of rearrangements. Experiments on the SAGE-10k and SceneSmith datasets show that SceneDesigner3D improves prompt adherence and computed design principle scores over baselines by up to 5.1% and 15.2%, respectively. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SceneDesigner3D：将 3D 室内场景重排表示为可编辑程序，由 VLM 智能体以进化方式变异候选布局，并用 VLM 评委打分与物理有效性校验，配合多样化存档提升重排多样性。

title: CIRKDV2: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation with Contextual Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
summary: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation often guide the student to mimic the teacher's structured information generated from an individual image. However, they ignore the global semantic relations across various images that are valuable for KD. This paper proposes Cross-Image Relational KD V2 (CIRKDV2), which focuses on transferring structured pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations modeled from global images in the dataset. A large teacher network often constructs a well-structured feature space in terms of global contextual dependencies. CIRKDV2 makes the student mimic the better structured semantic relations of the teacher, thus improving the feature representational capability. Beyond relational distillation, we further propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings to match the semantic level with the teacher. This avoids the semantic gap problem between the teacher and student occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. Experimental results on Cityscapes, ADE20K, Pascal VOC, and COCO-Stuff-164K demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic segmentation distillation methods by large margins across various network architectures. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出跨图像关系知识蒸馏 CIRKDV2，让学生网络模仿教师在全局图像上建模的像素—像素、像素—区域、通道关系，并用上下文聚合缓解师生语义差距，在多个语义分割基准上验证。

title: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published at The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. Such labels can arise from heuristics, sensor-derived events, or existing rule-based systems, allowing Split-RL to incorporate rule-derived structure while retaining a learned policy. We theoretically show how early gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information and characterize when the Split-RL score isolates conflicting updates. We focus on constrained RL and offline RL with mixed datasets, each balancing two objectives that conflict locally. Across domains with spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, Split-RL consistently outperforms existing methods by meeting the episodic cost budget while maintaining competitive rewards. In offline settings, Split-RL localizes the tradeoff between imitation and policy improvement, outperforming other methods and achieving near-expert performance across varying dataset sizes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Split-RL：一种在树构建阶段引入 guidance label 的梯度提升树算法，把相互冲突的奖励/梯度更新路由到互不重叠的状态空间区域，避免叶节点前过早聚合信号；在约束 RL 与离线混合数据 RL 上验证了局部冲突场景下的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用外部引导标签在训练中隔离局部冲突监督、防止梯度聚合丢失目标特异信息」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉/推理等多路监督（如轨迹监督与答案监督）的贡献分配与干扰问题提供可核查的借鉴线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
summary: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HOG-WAM，在世界-动作模型中用一个仅在训练期存在的 HOG 扩散 Transformer 作为未来梯度方向直方图的辅助监督，通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征，从而在推理时移除该模块的前提下提升视觉扰动下的控制成功率。

title: Transferring Architecture as an Optimization Prior
summary: Initialization determines the optimization "fate" of a model, going far beyond just setting the scale of its weights. It establishes a fundamental initial geometry over the input data, dictating certain aspects such as which examples are considered close and which representations gradient descent will naturally refine first. In this paper, we view the initial geometry of a network as an optimization prior and ask whether a network can change its optimization prior by referencing a completely different architecture. To investigate this question, we use an initialization procedure where a target network is aligned to the representational geometry of a randomly initialized guide network before any downstream training occurs. Crucially, alignment to the guide network cannot transfer learned features, never receives gradients, and does not use labels. We demonstrate that this cross-architecture transfer of "fate" benefits the target network in two key domains: (1) instilling the optimization benefits of depth into shallow networks by aligning them to deeper networks, and (2) transferring representational granularity by using fine-resolution networks to shape the geometry of networks with coarser representations. In both cases, the alignment results in improved downstream performance of the target network. Ultimately, this demonstrates that a model's architectural destiny can be decoupled from its physical structure and explicitly modified at initialization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把随机初始化网络形成的「初始几何」视为优化先验，提出在训练前将目标网络的表示几何对齐到一个完全不同的随机初始化引导网络，并证明这种跨架构对齐可以把深层网络的深度收益与细粒度表示迁移给浅层或粗粒度目标网络，从而提升下游性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「用无标签、无梯度的引导表示几何塑造目标网络内部状态」的思路，可供核查是否能用于塑造 latent 推理工作区、注入深度或表示粒度等结构性收益。

title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
summary: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently outperform the single best model. The clearest positive evidence is concentrated in portfolio-dependent Omni-MATH settings, while GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval show different ways in which routing can remain hard or predictor-sensitive. Our practical recommendation is that routing gains should be reported together with routeability diagnostics, tied-best analysis, portfolio construction details, and family-corrected statistical tests.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 routeability-first 审计协议 RAP 与 RouteabilityBench，在已有「基准×模型」分数矩阵上检查路由是否具备提升空间，并在 4 个基准、66 个 LLM 上发现常见路由增强通常难以稳定超过单一最佳模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先审计基准的收益空间、并列最优与统计校正」流程可供核查：能否用于辨别 LVR 相对直接回答的增益是否只是被基准饱和或并列评分掩盖，而非真实的状态或证据使用差异。

title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
summary: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPIRE，用单路脉冲相机流做光照鲁棒目标检测：由完整脉冲包构建外观视图，并从逐步加长的前缀构造累积视图与速率、边缘、差分图，用 ANN 特征与脉冲统计共同初始化脉冲神经元的膜电位和发放阈值，再以脉冲计数对比监督两分支并生成有界残差校正融合金字塔。

title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
summary: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. Executed actions, or decisions, taken in this manner are only as reliable as the model's predictive capabilities, and predictions in turn are only reliable within the model's experience. Epistemic uncertainty (EU) is the signal that marks where that experience ends. In this work we offer an extensive empirical study on how training objectives and architectures shape epistemic uncertainty of world models. More precisely, we present a controlled comparison of post-hoc EU (last-layer Laplace and ensembles) between two dominant models of different paradigms: 1) LeWorldModel (LeWM): A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), which predicts the next embedding without a decoder, and 2) DreamerV3: A recurrent state-space model (RSSM), which reconstructs the observation from a recurrent latent state. In ten simulated visual-control environments, we follow a controlled state perturbation of the environment state through every stage of the models up to the final EU estimate. We find that the RSSM attenuates the state perturbation through two mechanisms before it reaches an estimator on the predictor feature. Its recurrent update averages over context, so a change in a single frame reaches the state at a fraction of its size and recovers only as the change persists. Its reconstruction objective weights an entity by the pixels it covers, so a small object can be lost due to the training objective. The JEPA has neither mechanism and passes the change through all stages to the uncertainty. We further show that this translates to gaps in five uncertainty related downstream tasks, from unfamiliar-state detection to uncertainty-penalised planning: the RSSM uncertainty misses deviations that its own posterior registers, whereas the JEPA uncertainty reports what its model sees.

AI.brief_summary: 在十个视觉控制环境中逐阶段扰动环境状态，比较 JEPA（LeWorldModel）与 RSSM（DreamerV3）的训练目标与架构如何塑造事后 epistemic uncertainty 估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「循环更新平均化单帧变化、重建目标按像素覆盖加权而丢失小实体」的诊断，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 状态中的保留与坍缩；在预测特征上做不确定性估计也可能为 STOP 与证据筛选提供线索。

title: Diffusion Steering via Adaptive Reward Estimation and Resampling
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate images that satisfy complex prompts, yet often produce images that omit requested objects, attributes, or relationships. We ask if models can more reliably generate text-aligned images by redistributing probability toward their more successful outcomes. We propose TrailMix, a training-free method that uses the base model's distribution of possible outcomes to adaptively guide generation toward better text alignment. During denoising, TrailMix generates inexpensive lookahead images from parallel trajectories (trails) and scores their alignment with the prompt using an external judge. The resulting distribution of reward scores allows us to estimate how strongly to steer generation toward a desired alignment level. We use these estimates to reweight and resample trajectories, favoring more promising outcomes. Across three text-to-image benchmarks, TrailMix outperforms existing baselines, with particularly strong gains on rare multi-object compositions. We further extend TrailMix to targeted image editing and introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance), a systematic benchmark evaluating whether semantic edits preserve other image content. Experiments on SEAM-Bench and existing benchmark PIE-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for controlled image editing. Our results show how a model's own possible outcomes can inform reliable and controllable generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 TrailMix，在扩散去噪中从并行轨迹生成低成本 lookahead 图像，用外部评判器打分，并依据奖励分布自适应决定引导强度，通过重加权与重采样提升文本对齐，并扩展到图像编辑与 SEAM-Bench。

title: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
summary: We consider the problem of constructing knowledge bases for applications based on large language models, in which the structure of a knowledge base determines how an application can retrieve and connect the information needed to answer a question. We study Self-Structuring Learning, a setting in which questions and expected answers guide the construction of a persistent knowledge base whose editable structure can be a graph schema or the organization of linked knowledge documents. We propose Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which diagnoses discrepancies between expected answers and responses obtained through the current knowledge base. At each round, the method proposes a structural edit, rebuilds the knowledge base, and adopts the edit when the learning loss decreases. The retained structure is evaluated on other questions about the same sources. By randomizing over candidate edits, we express the loss change of an edit as a derivative with respect to the probability of selecting it, and we evaluate joint edits as single candidates because their changes interact. Schema Descent instantiates the method for graph schemas. In experiments on large documents, each a bundle of research papers, the updated knowledge cards and graph schemas obtain higher mean Answer F1 on held-out generated questions than their initial structures, with schema gains in every document. On human questions, mean F1 rises for schemas and falls for cards: the updated structures serve the kind of question they were learned from.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究「自结构化学习」：在问答反馈下迭代改写持久知识库的结构（图 schema 或链接文档组织），每轮提出结构编辑、重建知识库，仅在留出问题上的学习损失下降时保留，并用对候选编辑的随机化把损失变化表达为选择概率的导数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散结构编辑＋用采样近似梯度做贡献分配、并考察对其他问题的泛化」可能为 LVR 中离散决策（如 THINK/LOOK/STOP 或轨迹片段）的信用分配与证据组织提供可核查线索，但论文本身面向文本知识库检索，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
summary: Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a simple and strong baseline for predicting financial events such as fraud. Yet institutions do not act on probabilities; they act on decisions whose consequences are asymmetric and heteroscedastic: the cost of a missed high-value fraud and that of a wrongly declined small purchase are not the same. The standard bridge is post-hoc Bayes-optimal thresholding of calibrated probabilities under a cost matrix. We ask whether fine-tuning the model to the decision objective can do better. We fine-tune the same pretrained model so that its restricted softmax over label tokens (already a distribution over business actions) maximizes expected utility under an institution-specified, amount-scaled cost matrix. Because the reward is a known function of (action, outcome, amount) and the outcome is observed in the data, the expected-utility objective and its gradient are available in closed form. This is example-dependent cost-sensitive learning whose per-example loss is linear in the predicted probability, with no sampling, critics, or advantage estimation. A KL anchor to the pretrained model and an auxiliary language-modeling term preserve calibration and the generative event model. A sampled, group-normalized (GRPO-style) variant provides the extension point to trajectory-level rewards.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对金融事件预测，将预训练自回归表格 transformer 的标签 token 受限 softmax 视为动作分布，在金额缩放的代价矩阵下用闭式期望效用梯度做决策导向微调，并以 KL 锚定和辅助语言建模项保持校准与生成能力，另给出 GRPO 式轨迹级奖励变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按代价/效用直接优化决策分布」及轨迹级奖励扩展，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益成本权衡与轨迹监督设计提供借鉴，但该工作不涉及视觉证据或 latent 推理状态，需核查该线性损失能否迁移到 latent 轨迹评价。

title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
summary: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs (0.385 vs. 0.459), sitting 1.0 J&F point below the dense-encoder baseline; at ViT-B the gain over ALGM 0.95 is +3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]. On DAVIS 2017 val it stays within -0.19 J&F of the dense encoder at ViT-S (-0.12 at ViT-B). Controls qualify the result: protecting only the previous mask under ALGM matches or exceeds accuracy at higher FLOPs (0.486), so expectation and surprise mainly reduce counted encoder compute. Practically, lower counted encoder compute did not reduce startup-inclusive mean Cutie step time on a 12-video LVOS sample (3%-8% lower in steady state; an equally engineered ALGM is faster at ViT-S and ViT-B). Section 5.2 separately examines a Cutie permanent-memory schedule and its latency and memory trade-offs. Code: https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv

AI.brief_summary: 为长视频目标分割中的冻结 DINOv3 ViT 设计免训练 focus map：用速度平移与块匹配掩码的并集、相机补偿的 surprise 检查，在预测目标处保留全分辨率、其余区域做更粗的 token 合并，并与基线合并在 LVOS V2、DAVIS 上比较精度、FLOPs 与延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 按预测位置与不确定性决定计算粒度，可作为 LVR 中动态计算分配与视觉证据筛选的借鉴线索；其控制结果指出计数 FLOPs 下降未转化为实际延迟收益，可供核查此类计算节省主张的成本核算。

title: Towards Closing the Performance Gap in Cross-Modal Place Recognition
summary: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) matches natural language descriptions against databases of geo-tagged reference images, enabling localization without visual queries. Despite its potential for language-guided navigation, existing vision-language models lag far behind visual place recognition (VPR) baselines, even after task adaptation. Unlike general-purpose text-to-image retrieval, place recognition relies on subtle local cues to distinguish visually similar locations. We therefore hypothesize that a primary bottleneck in CMPR is capturing fine-grained correspondences between image regions and text details, which requires higher visual token granularity, strong text representation capacity, and local cross-modal matching. To address this challenge, we propose CrossPlace, a two-stage CMPR framework. Stage 1 performs global retrieval by pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder, while Stage 2 refines top candidates using a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker. Through systematic analysis, we isolate the drivers of retrieval accuracy and show that visual token density provides the largest performance improvement, while text encoder capacity and task fine-tuning offer complementary gains. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we also extend CMPR evaluation to city-scale and severe weather and illumination settings. Across all existing and new benchmarks, CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 improvements over prior cross-modal methods, closes the gap to unimodal text retrieval, and narrows it to unimodal VPR. Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CrossPlace 两阶段跨模态地点识别框架：第一阶段用对齐的 DINOv2 视觉编码器加渐进微调的 BGE 文本编码器做全局检索，第二阶段用轻量 token 级 cross-attention 重排候选，并分析视觉 token 密度、文本编码器容量等因素对精度的贡献。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 token 级跨模态局部匹配与视觉 token 密度消融，可供核查细粒度视觉证据能否在表示中被保留、局部对齐对区分相似场景的作用，但该工作是检索而非推理期状态生成，迁移需谨慎。

title: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
summary: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PhysReader：仅用仿真训练前馈预测器，从单段真实落地视频估计可变形物体的密度归一化刚度和屈服应力，并发现仿真验证给出的输入排序在真实域完全反转，同时构建了含 16 个物体的真实评测集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「仿真中最有信息的 3D 表示在真实域反而最差、2D 光流最可迁移」的诊断，以及用可见精确 3D 形变的教师蒸馏隐空间的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉表示选择、证据筛选与代理评价失配问题。

title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
summary: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.

AI.brief_summary: 面向实时长视频生成提出异步 agentic 记忆：记忆 agent 只读已揭示的提示词，为每个实体维护文本状态与演化图像，合成全局与分镜记忆图像由辅助 GPU 预填充进生成器 attention sink，并用 RL 加下游视频结果校准的图像奖励训练小模型决定「该记什么」，在 LongStory-Online 上提升长程实体与场景一致性且额外开销约 1%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在下一个提示到来前学习选择该记住什么」的记忆选择策略与外部状态预填充机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态写入及缓存/计算预算取舍提供可核查线索，但该工作目标是外观一致性而非推理，迁移需自行判断。

title: LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
summary: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE achieves 5.2-6.2x faster encoding and 3.0-3.3x faster decoding than the official VAE with higher PSNR. Paired with our dedicated inference infrastructure, LiveVAE pushes the speedup to 13.4x with almost no quality loss. Code and models will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析预训练视频 VAE 的有效感受野，发现编解码主要依赖时空邻域，据此提出基于因果窗口注意力的流式编码器与解码器，并通过蒸馏加联合微调保持原有 latent 空间，实现更快且 KV 缓存有界的视频 VAE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「局部感受野即可」的证据和有限缓存流式状态更新设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、推理状态缓存与视觉编码成本的权衡提供可核查线索，但原文不涉及推理生成或答案对 latent 的使用。

title: High-Fidelity Image Matting with Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for image matting by transferring generative priors learned from large-scale pretraining. However, existing approaches largely rely on latent diffusion models, whose compressed representations and VAE-based reconstruction introduce a mismatch with the high-frequency precision required for matting. We present PixelMatte, a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for high-fidelity image matting. We show that strong image-conditioned matting capabilities can be acquired even from a pure text-to-image model without paired image-to-image pretraining. Our approach reuses the backbone's native patch embedding to jointly process the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte as spatially aligned tokens, enabling direct pixel-space prediction without additional condition encoders or adapters. With pixel-accurate synthetic supervision and real-image fine-tuning, PixelMatte predicts alpha mattes in a single forward pass. Two lightweight calibration modules, LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner, further improve regional opacity accuracy and boundary fidelity. Experiments across four benchmarks and two distinct pixel diffusion backbones demonstrate substantial improvements over existing methods, reducing SAD and gradient errors by 24-44% relative to RenderMatte on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, while achieving competitive performance on AIM-500 and RenderMatte-2K. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pixel-space generative priors for precision-sensitive image matting. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PixelMatte，将预训练的像素空间扩散 Transformer 改造用于图像抠图：复用原生 patch embedding 把输入图像、trimap 与加噪 alpha 作为空间对齐 token 联合处理，单次前向预测 alpha，并用 LayerShift 与 High-Pass Refiner 改善区域不透明度与边缘精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心论点「VAE 压缩潜表示与高频精度需求不匹配」可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否在 latent 状态里坍缩、是否需要保留像素级旁路或高通道输出路径，但迁移到多模态推理仍是推测。

title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
summary: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BioScore 基准：用稀疏自编码器把病理图像编码器的 patch embedding 分解为稀疏特征并聚类成固定组，以同组织空间转录组为参考，量化每组对 52 种 marker gene 定义细胞身份的表达特异性，从而无需标签地评估 8 个病理基础模型与 3 个自然图像模型表征了哪些生物学内容。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稀疏特征分解＋聚类＋与外部参考做特异性对齐」的度量思路可供核查能否迁移到 LVR，用于判断 latent 状态是否保留任务相关的具体视觉证据；但原文只评编码器表征、不涉及推理与生成过程，迁移属推测。

title: Geophysics-informed invertible operator network for Bayesian geophysical inversion
summary: Geophysical inverse problems are inherently ill-posed because of sparse observations and measurement noise. Classical sampling-based Bayesian inference methods, such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), are computationally prohibitive because they require many forward simulations. Data-driven machine-learning methods often struggle to produce physically consistent solutions when training data are limited. To address these issues, we propose a geophysics-informed invertible operator network (GI-ION) that integrates an invertible neural network (INN) within a deep operator-learning framework for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion. The INN serves as the branch network and transforms the model parameters into branch coefficients that represent the forward solution and a latent variable that captures uncertainty in the inverse problem. By learning the forward operator and enforcing statistical independence between the branch coefficients and the latent variable, GI-ION enables efficient sampling from a learned conditional approximation, even with sparse boundary observations. We validated GI-ION on three representative cases: 1D surface-wave dispersion and travel-time tomography for a 2D synthetic random-field model and a seismic-slice model. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust performance across diverse problem settings and efficient conditional sampling.

AI.brief_summary: 提出地球物理信息引导的可逆算子网络 GI-ION，把 INN 作为 branch 网络嵌入深度算子学习框架，在学得前向算子的同时用隐变量刻画反演不确定性，并借统计独立性约束在稀疏边界观测下实现高效条件采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用可逆映射把分支系数与不确定性隐变量分离、并以独立性约束支持的潜在空间采样，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态与内容／不确定性的解耦及多种 latent 假设有关，可供核查；但属地球物理反演，与视觉推理联系较远。

title: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
summary: As AI systems become increasingly capable of executing and evaluating experiments, ideation is emerging as a bottleneck in automated scientific and engineering iteration. In many real-world domains, useful ideas are sparse and their validation is costly, making direct online exploration inefficient. We observe that repository evolution provides a scalable source of reusable technical experience: code changes record concrete technical hypotheses, while subsequent revisions, adoption, and reuse provide signals about their utility. Based on this observation, we propose REI, a Repository Evolution-driven Ideation framework that learns reusable ideation policies from repository evolution, injecting domain-specific technical experience into model parameters and reducing reliance on costly trial-and-error. We further identify a hidden failure mode in quality-driven ideation optimization: semantic diversity collapse. Although generated ideas can remain lexically diverse, they increasingly concentrate in a small number of dominant method families, limiting cross-task generalization and long-tail exploration. To address this problem, we introduce Semantic Prior Optimization and Debiasing (SPOD), a diversity-preserving alignment mechanism that makes method identity explicit, corrects category-level reward bias, and limits redundant accumulation within the same method family while retaining strong representatives. Experiments on public benchmarks and a real-world industrial setting demonstrate improvements in ideation quality, method diversity, cross-task generalization, and long-tail exploration.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 REI，从代码仓库演进（提交内容及后续修订、采用与复用信号）中离线学习可复用的构思策略并注入模型参数，同时用 SPOD 缓解「语义多样性坍缩」——表面词汇多样但集中于少数方法族。
AI.relevance_reason: 其语义多样性坍缩的诊断与方法族级去偏，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设同质化、假设多样性监督提供可核查线索，但不是视觉或多模态推理研究。

title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
summary: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost. We investigate whether general-purpose decision models can guide tuning, using Jev as a deployed representative that returns structured choices and numeric scores across diverse tasks. To assess where it helps, we compare its use as an optimizer, performance predictor, and region guider against conventional methods and a large language model (LLM) on eight AI tuning tasks. Conventional optimizers attain rank 1 in six of eight comparisons. Similarly, established predictors outperform Jev in seven. Through region guidance, however, it finds configurations with lower perplexity than those selected by the native tuner, offering a quality gain when additional decision time and API fees are acceptable. These findings yield actionable recommendations on selecting the decision role, retaining conventional predictors, and balancing tuning quality against cost.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察通用决策模型（以 Jev 为代表）能否指导 AI 配置调优，在八个调优任务上将其分别作为优化器、性能预测器和区域引导器与传统方法及 LLM 对比，发现仅在区域引导角色下、允许额外决策时间与费用时可获得质量提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「额外决策时间与 API 成本换取质量」的角色分工结论，可能与 LVR 中多花 latent 计算步是否值得、如何决定继续搜索或停止的问题形成类比，可供核查而非已验证的迁移。

title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. A person who looks through up to 3 base images finds a correct one as often as one RL image is correct. On the prompts that ask for a position, RL is far ahead: a person finds a correct image among 8 base images for only 52% of the prompts, against 92% for one RL image. Over all prompts, our primary test, which we fixed in advance, finds best-of-16 with the VLM picker 9.3 points behind one RL image when both automatic judges must pass an image. People see a smaller gap, 5.5 and 6.5 points in two checks. FLUX.1-dev shows a similar gap in the same test. RL also solves 20 prompts that the base model misses in 128 tries, and 1,024 tries recover half of them. The automatic judges are wrong in opposite directions: a detector-based judge like the reward, as used in our primary test, reports a larger gap than people see, and VLM judges report little or none. title: Sequential Testing on Complex and High Dimensional Data Streams Leveraging Unsupervised Model Errors
summary: We propose two general, distribution-free test statistics for binary Sequential Hypothesis Testing (SHT) and Sequential Change Point Detection (SCPD) respectively, in streaming environments where the data (e.g., network traffic metadata) are too complicated for the exact probabilistic modeling required by conventional likelihood ratio-driven tests. Our framework also addresses the challenge of information asymmetry, where data is available only from the null/pre-change regime and not from the alternative/post-change one such as zero-day attacks or emerging disease related regimes. The proposed statistics monitor the errors of a predictive or reconstructive machine learning model trained solely on null/pre-change data, relying on imperfect generalization (the model's performance will degrade when deployed on data from the alternative/post-change class). Under mild assumptions on the model's errors, we establish rigorous analytical guarantees: strict non-asymptotic error control for SHT, and explicit bounds on the Average Run Length (ARL) and the Expected Detection Delay (EDD) for SCPD. Extensive evaluations in target tracking, chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world network security datasets, demonstrate that our framework consistently satisfies prescribed constraints where existing algorithms succumb to inflated missed detections and/or false alarms. Finally, because our methods operate on scalar errors without requiring online retraining or kernel evaluations, they are highly scalable.

title: FERRETS: A Scalable Symbolic Transform for Time Series Classification
comment: 42 pages including references and appendices, 19 figures
summary: Dictionary methods for time series build bags of symbolic words from subsequences, but the accurate ones scale poorly. Against other families of methods, their accuracy no longer pays for their cost. We present FERRETS, a label-free dictionary transform built on WEASEL~2. It keys windows of random length and dilation into exact eight-bit words, adds a level word of each window's mean and spread, and on multivariate data adds cross-channel words. We compare it with leading classifiers, deep networks and foundation models included, on the UCR, Multiverse and MONSTER archives. FERRETS is the fastest of the eleven methods timed on UCR under a ten-thread budget. Of the ten others, only MultiRocket-Hydra is significantly more accurate, taking 24.7 times as long. FERRETS is not significantly different from WEASEL~2, the most accurate earlier dictionary method, which takes 125 times as long, and is significantly ahead of the other dictionary methods. On the Multiverse core, it is not significantly different in accuracy from HIVE-COTE~2 and MultiRocket-Hydra, though behind both on UCR. It is also significantly more accurate than five frozen foundation models on UCR's published split. On the MONSTER problems both complete, MiniRocket takes 3.7 times as long to fit as the streaming FERRETS classifier, which is significantly more accurate.
